tiles.processing: Native 1 m EPSG:5845 DTM; native tiles mosaicked before bilinear sampling. Scene grid mapped directly to SWEREF 99 TM (scene contract in reference; no geographic round trip). Runtime grid 5 m; RH2000 retained; vertical exaggeration 1; no invented relief or hole filling. Retained bridge decks (classified as ground) removed like other bridges: scripts/data/dtm-retained-decks.json, scripts/geo/dtm_corrections.py.

mesh.errorReference: Max |plane - DTM| over the native Lantmäteriet 1 m DTM pixel centres (EPSG:5845) of each class in each triangle. feature = road/path/tram surfaces, rail corridors (15 m), building footprints, 10 m either side of shorelines; track = the at-grade running-line track bed (2.5 m either side of the rail; no sidings or yards; Step 5); built-up = within 30 m of a mapped building footprint (featureBuiltUp, landBuiltUp); urban = built-up land cover elsewhere; open = other land; water = open water. Vertices are the 5 m grid nodes (no new heights).

patches.method: The rendered ground is an RTIN over the 5 m DTM nodes (surfaceMesh.ts). Draped roads follow its triangles, which are larger than the road: where a triangle reaches over a wall, terrace or verge, the asphalt is twisted (Batch B: 829 cross-sections with a crease > 0.3 m). Here, inside prototype boxes, every RTIN leaf touched by the drawn asphalt of an ordinary (draped) road is re-triangulated so that the asphalt outline (the union of road strips and junction fans, exactly as cityMesh.ts draws them) consists of mesh edges:
